recovery_fraction: For each shocked trajectory, Q_capacity(t)=1-[C_control(t)-C_shocked(t)]/[C_control(0)-C_shocked(0)], with the no-shock shock_fraction=1.0 trajectory matched on seed, focal locality, capital multiplier, and time.
eligible_trajectory: A shocked trajectory with finite Q_capacity at every scheduled observation and at least 8 observations. No trajectory is excluded because recovery is weak or negative.

functional_forms.linear: Q(t)=a*t; one fitted parameter a, zero intercept fixed by the matched-gap construction.
functional_forms.exponential: Q(t)=A*(1-exp(-t/tau)); two fitted parameters A and tau; A constrained to [-5,5], tau constrained to [1,100000] days.

fit_protocol.aic: Fit each candidate to all scheduled observations including t=0. AIC=n*log(max(SSE/n,1e-15))+2*k, with k=1 for linear and k=2 for exponential.
fit_protocol.temporal_validation: Sort by time; the first ceil(0.70*n) observations form the fit set and the remaining observations form the held-out late-time set. Fit both candidates only on the early set and compare RMSE on the held-out set.
fit_protocol.optimizer: Bounded nonlinear least squares for the exponential. Initial A is clipped final observed Q to [-2,2] with a nonzero fallback; initial tau=360 days. Optimization failure counts as an exponential loss for both AIC and held-out RMSE.
fit_protocol.tau_summary: A fitted tau is scientifically eligible for the within-shock CV calculation only when the full-data exponential fit converges with finite tau and A>0. If a shock stratum lacks at least four eligible tau estimates, the tau-stability gate fails for that stratum.

first_passage.Q50: First scheduled observation with Q_capacity>=0.50; no interpolation.
first_passage.Q80: First scheduled observation with Q_capacity>=0.80; no interpolation.

promotion_gate_restated.tau_cv_within_each_shock_stratum: <=0.50 with at least four eligible tau fits per stratum

guard: This operationalization resolves fitting details only; it does not alter the parent contract's scientific thresholds or synthetic-only interpretation.
